faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Quick answers to common study-abroad questions.

cost.q: How much does a year of study abroad cost on average?
cost.a: It depends on the country: Taiwan ~80–200M VND/year, Korea 120–280M, Japan 180–320M, Singapore 300–650M, Europe 200–500M. Scholarships can lower this significantly.

timing.q: How far in advance should I start preparing my application?
timing.a: Ideally 12–18 months before enrollment. ALOHA will assess your ability and build a detailed roadmap for you.

language.q: What's the minimum language level required?
language.a: Taiwan: HSK 4+ or TOCFL Band A2; Korea: TOPIK 3+ (D-2); Japan: JLPT N3 for most schools; Singapore & Europe: IELTS 6.0–6.5+.

scholarshipSupport.q: Does ALOHA help with scholarship applications?
scholarshipSupport.a: Yes. ALOHA works with Taiwanese government scholarships, GKS (Korea), MEXT (Japan), Erasmus+ (Europe) and more — supporting your application and interview until you get a result.

workAfter.q: Can I stay and work after graduating?
workAfter.a: Yes: Taiwan (post-graduation work visa), Korea (D-10 → E-7), Japan (engineer/work visa), Singapore (Employment Pass), Europe (varies by country). ALOHA will advise on the specific route.

noLanguageYet.q: Can I study abroad even with no language foundation yet?
noLanguageYet.a: Yes. ALOHA offers a 6–12 month local language-prep track before you apply, or a 1-year prep program abroad.
